title: Who Is the Mexican Drug Kingpin Known as El Chapo Isidro?
summary_full: The kingpin, Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, was captured in a violent operation in Mexico. He was one of the F.B.I.’s 10 most wanted fugitives.
